description: Set a booking's status — e.g. confirm a pending booking (PAID/PART), put it on HOLD or WAIT(list), or cancel it (VOID/STOP). Reversible: set it back to the previous status the same way. Does NOT record a payment. Optionally triggers the account's customer notifications. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/update.

booking_id.description: The booking code identifying the booking, e.g. CFPP-290317.

notify.description: Send the account's notifications for this change (default false).

status_id.description: The new status code. Defaults: PEND, HOLD, PART, PAID, WAIT, STOP, VOID (plus any custom statuses in Manage > Layout > Statuses).

name: checkfront_update_booking_status
title: Change a booking's status
